summary.en: Federal forces are advancing in Tigray while militia attacks near the Kenya-Ethiopia border have killed civilians and displaced thousands, pushing refugee numbers above 50,000 in Kenya. Ethiopian drones are operating over Sudan and RSF drones are launching from Ethiopian territory against Sudanese targets, leading to diplomatic expulsions and consular closures. Ethiopia accuses Eritrea of directing a Tigray rebel offensive with Egyptian support, and Eritrean forces have engaged in drone and artillery strikes near Badme. The army chief has labeled Eritrea a vector of chaos and accused Egypt of supporting the TPLF. The conflict caused 2,824 battle-related deaths in 2024, according to UCDP.
summary.nb: Den føderale styrken rykker frem i Tigray, mens militsangrep nær grensen mellom Kenya og Etiopia har drept sivile og fordrevet tusenvis, noe som har ført til at antallet flyktninger i Kenya har steget over 50 000. Etiopiske droner opererer over Sudan, og RSF-militsen sender droner fra etiopisk territorium mot sudanske mål, noe som har ført til diplomatiske utvisninger og konsulære nedleggelser. Etiopia anklager Eritrea for å lede et Tigray-rebelleoffensiv med egyptisk støtte, og eritreiske styrker har utført drone- og artilleriangrep nær Badme. Hæroverlegen har kalt Eritrea en kaosvektor og anklaget Egypt for å støtte TPLF. Konflikten forårsaket 2 824 dødsfall i kamper i 2024, ifølge UCDP.

background.title: Fano insurgency
background.extract: The Fano insurgency or Amhara war is an armed conflict and insurgency in the Amhara Region of Ethiopia that began in April 2023 between the Fano militia and the Ethiopian government. The conflict started after the government attempted to dissolve the Amhara Special Forces and other regional forces as part of a plan to reform and centralize the country's security apparatus, and integrate them into the federal armed forces. This move led to protests and armed resistance by local forces under Fano.
